changes.now: Detective Eddy Costa, who held his own gun to his head that day, still has nightmares about it and offers to work with Jessica.
changes.proposed: Detective Eddy Costa, who held his own gun to his head that day, had nightmares about it until Kilgrave died, and offers to work with Jessica.
changes.evidence: In AKA The Octopus, Costa tells Jessica he had nightmares of holding his own gun to his head in the precinct, but 'the dreams stopped the day you took that asshole out.' He no longer has them.
